records.title: Université Paris-Saclay IDEX International Master's Scholarships

validation.notes: Official_source_url was fetched first and it is the official scholarship programme page on universite-paris-saclay.fr. Its site header renders the institutional wordmark from the official media path /sites/default/files/media/2019-12/logo-ups.svg with alt text 'Université Paris-Saclay (aller à l'accueil)'. Direct GET of that asset returned HTTP 200, Content-Type image/svg+xml, 4994 bytes. The SVG source was read and is a vector wordmark, viewBox 0 0 190 66.7, with the two-part lockup ('université' above 'PARIS-SACLAY') plus the Saclay dot motif, filled #62003C (the Université Paris-Saclay brand plum) — a full-colour primary logo, not an icon or badge. Filename does not contain favicon/icon/apple-touch/safari-pinned-tab. Not a social avatar, not a screenshot, not a third-party mirror. The white reversed variant (/sites/default/files/media/2019-12/logo-ups-white_1.svg) also exists and was not used because the primary header mark is the safer default. Nothing on the page identifies a separate IDEX programme-specific mark, so the institutional brand mark is the correct identity for this record.

records.title: Tampere University tuition fee scholarship (50%) and early bird offer

validation.notes: The shard's official_source_url (https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/financial-matters/tuition-fees-and-scholarships) was fetched first and is live and official — it states verbatim 'Tampere University tuition fee scholarship is an exclusive opportunity awarded to a limited number of the best-performing applicants' and 'Tampere University tuition fee scholarships awarded at admission cover 50% of the tuition fees for the programme duration', plus the early bird offer section, so the record's identity is confirmed. That page carries only decorative photography (e.g. banner_tuition_tau_restricted.png, campus skyline) and the inline-SVG header mark; it publishes no standalone logo file. The official TAU brand asset was therefore taken from the official Tampere Universities host sites.tuni.fi: https://sites.tuni.fi/app/uploads/6639ccd5-logo_tau_2line_eng_purple_rgb.jpg, alt text 'Logo of Tampere University.' on that domain. Direct GET returned HTTP 200, image/jpeg, 53787 bytes; the file was opened and visually confirmed as the two-line purple 'Tampere University' lockup with the university's TAU arc mark, 615x353 px. Same MEDIUM caveat as record 265: hosting page is the website-builder demo page, not a dedicated brand page; www.tuni.fi/en/tau/news/for-media instead routes logo requests to the marketing team. Favicon/apple-touch-icon/safari-pinned-tab assets and the TUNI/TAMK marks were rejected.

records.title: MBZUAI Graduate Funding for M.Sc. and Ph.D. Students

validation.notes: No official, retrievable MBZUAI logo file exists. Findings: (1) official_source_url https://mbzuai.ac.ae/admissions/graduate-masters-admissions returns HTTP 403 to plain HTTP fetches (even with a desktop browser User-Agent) and had to be rendered in a real browser session; when rendered, the page's masthead logo is an INLINE SVG component — <div class="navigation-main-logo"><a href="/" aria-label="MBZUAI Home"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="198" height="56" viewBox="0 0 198 56" ...> — with no src attribute and therefore no URL that can be stored as image_url. (2) A full network trace of the graduate master's admissions page and the University Catalogue page returned only these SVG/PNG assets, none of which is a usable logo file: /images/BackgroundPatternNavy500.svg, /images/BackgroundPatternSand500.svg, /images/BackgroundPatternWhite.svg, /images/bullet_point_sand_bg.svg, /_nuxt/primeicons.*.svg (UI icon sprite) and /favicon.svg. (3) The declared <link rel="icon"> and <link rel="apple-touch-icon"> set is /favicon.svg, /apple-touch-icon.png, /apple-touch-icon-152x152.png, /apple-touch-icon-120x120.png — every one of these is a favicon/apple-touch-icon asset and is rejected without exception by the logo rules, so /favicon.svg was NOT used. (4) An official brand hub was advertised at https://mbzuai.ac.ae/brand/ ('Primary logos / Download now', 'Download full brand guidelines'), but on the live site that URL redirects to the MBZUAI homepage (https://mbzuai.ac.ae/, title 'Home'), so no brand-asset page or logo download is actually published. (5) The official Media Center (https://mbzuai.ac.ae/media and https://mbzuai.ac.ae/the-node/media-center) states verbatim: 'For images of our faculty and leadership team, or for permission to use our logos for partnerships and collaborations, please request using the form below' — i.e. MBZUAI gates logo use behind a request form and publishes no direct logo asset. (6) og:image on the admissions page is https://mbzuai.ac.ae/content/media/2026-09/fallback-image_0.jpg, a generic fallback/decorative hero image, which is rejected as decorative hero art. Conclusion: official absence. A favicon or an inline-SVG-derived guess would be fake branding, so image_url stays null.
